title: RuneScape Dragonwilds: Preparing For Velgar's Rise (Tier3-4)
author: Primitive Nomad
description:
This is day 2 of our Fresh playthrough after 1.0 Each episode we have goals in mind. But as you know this can change overtime depending on  what we get into. Our main goals are usually Power level increase, and resource grinding. We have geared up and gathered everything we need to take on Velgar!

THANK YOU for the support! I truly appreciate you!💚🤟🏼

LIKE & SUB for everything Dragonwilds!

I've been covering Dragonwilds since day one, following every update, reveal, patch, and development milestone, so I'll also share insights and details that many new players may have missed.

If you're excited about the future of RuneScape: Dragonwilds, make sure to subscribe for guides, news, updates, breakdowns, rankings, tips, and everything happening as the game continues to evolve.

#RuneScapeDragonwilds #Dragonwilds #RuneScape #SurvivalGames #OpenWorldGames #Gaming

I have officially partnered with Shockbyte for dedicated servers for Runescape Dragon Wilds. Use my referral code to support the channel!
